title: Jesus... I Have To Tell My Parents Tomorrow

bible.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... tomorrow I have to tell my parents I am leaving the course they paid for. How do I even start that sentence? 😭

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: My dad worked double shifts for this. I keep practising the sentence and I cannot get through it without crying.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are not crying because you are unsure. You are crying because you love them.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone says follow your heart. Nobody says what to do when following it breaks the people who gave you everything.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tell Me honestly. Are you running from something hard, or walking toward something true?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Walking toward. I am sure of that part. I am just not sure I can survive their faces.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then say it plainly and let them have their first reaction. Their first reaction is not their final one.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: And if it is? If they never look at me the same way again?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I am not asking you to stop needing them. I am telling you that if their arms close, Mine do not.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever had to disappoint someone you love to be honest? 🙏 Say it kindly, say it anyway.
